item.title: Show HN: Rmux – A programmable terminal multiplexer with a Playwright-style SDK
item.description:
📝 io with Cargo: cargo install rmux --locked From a local checkout: cargo install --path. CLI Quickstart rmux new-session -d -s work rmux split-window -h -t work rmux send-keys -t work 'echo "hello from rmux"' Enter rmux attach-session -t work Use command help locally: rmux list-commands rmux new-session --help rmux split-window --help SDK Quickstart [dependencies] rmux-sdk = "0. conf On Windows, RMUX reads.
🔗 Read more: https://github.com/helvesec/rmux
